newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Miss. nuke seen at full next week.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Miss. nuke seen at full next week.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 1,173 megawatt Grand Gulf 1 nuclear power plant will likely reach full power next week following a scheduled maintenance outage, a company spokesman said.
Restart testing of the unit will take "about a week," said spokesman Terry Young, adding the unit will reach full power shortly after the testing is completed.
The Port Gibson, Miss., unit was producing at about 45 percent of capacity and increasing power as of early Wednesday, according to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
The plant was shut Oct 19 for scheduled refueling and maintenance. It resumed electrical output late last week.
